demoted._modifier: Rust never lets visibility and `mut` occupy the same slot: visibility precedes an item, `mut` attaches to a binding, a reference or a `static` AFTER the keyword. One alternation across both is exactly the rule that accepted `mut use x;`. Both members are concrete types occurring nowhere else, so facet membership selects the same nodes.
demoted._parameter: Rust's parameter list is ordered: a `self` receiver is only ever the first parameter and the C-variadic `...` only ever the last, so the three parameter node types cannot share one supertype derivation without the grammar accepting `fn f(a: i32, self)`. All three are concrete types occurring nowhere but a parameter list, so facet membership selects the same nodes.
